text:
jing-li: heads-up: ap-southeast-2 rack r23 GPUs reporting repeated correctable ECC spikes. aps2-r23-n03 crashed twice and auto-rebooted. starting soft drain on the suspicious nodes.
ops-bot: [ALERT] GPU_ECC_RATE_HIGH on ap-southeast-2/aps2-r23-n0[1-4] — 12 events / 10m. Incident created: INC-20260318-87
maria_ops: thanks jing — are user-facing errors or client 5xx showing?
kyle_infra: seeing small tail-latency bump for hosted-api in ap-southeast-2, ~5% increase at p95. routing layer already pushed a tiny % to eu-west as a safety net.
samir: can someone drop the exact drain command? I'll take ownership of node ops while vendor looks.
jing-li: running this now:
```bash
redwoodctl nodes drain --region ap-southeast-2 --nodes aps2-r23-n01,aps2-r23-n02,aps2-r23-n03 --reason "ECC spike / thermal sensor flap"
```
I'll keep them soft-drained (no hard-evict) for 10m while we watch regen. switching latency-sensitive routes to model-variant: redwood/model-x-small to reduce KV pressure.
oncall-amy: increased autoscaler min for the pool from 8 -> 10 to buy headroom and disabled rack-level burst.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: fallback policy engaged. Traffic split updated: 10% -> eu-west, 5% -> us-central, remaining local with degraded model. See rollout ID: rb-20260318-314
ashton-hw: vendor ETA ~45m. onsite tech will bring spare boards and a spare node if replacement required. prepping RMA if reboots/repairs don't clear the ECC rate.
kyle_infra: please confirm KV cache invalidation plan — we don't want a regen storm that spikes costs.
jing-li: plan: soft-drain -> health-check probe -> hard-evict if pod stuck >3m to free KV. Watching token regen rate and queue depth now.
maria_ops: cost FYI: cross-region shift + autoscaler bump estimated +$180/hr while this is active. adding note to incident.
samir: I'll track affected customers and list any that hit elevated p95. posting updates to #support-escalations.
infra-sre: if vendor needs >2hr for hardware swap we should open a maintenance window and inform customers.
oncall-amy: created maintenance: MW-aps2-r23-20260319-0200 (2hr window). Notifying enterprise customers per SLA.
maria_ops: :thumbsup: keep me posted for any billing flags.
jing-li: nodes marked drained, health checks currently flapping but no hard-evicts yet. monitoring dashboards for ECC counters and GPU temp. will update when vendor onsite or if we see another crash.
